description:
My daughter turned 18 and got a new car on her 18th birthday so she no longer needs her Cruze.

We have owned the car for two years and the car has always done us well. About 18 months ago we replaced the entire cooling system with all new hoses since it was leaking antifreeze. Apparently this is a problem for Cruze's so this problem has already been fixed. It was like eight hundred bucks. Also, before we bought the car, the previous owner replaced the turbo or at least that is what the dealership told me when I purchased it. I have no way of verifying this.

As with any twelve year old car with over 100k miles, there are a few things that need fixed:

- Car needs new tires. At higher speeds the steering wheel will vibrate slightly, but this is from the tires that need replaced.
- I have to add a quart of oil in between oil changes since the oil cooler seals need replaced and it leaks under the car.
- At low RPM's (idle in drive) it seems to have developed a rattle, but this goes away when you start driving it. I'm sure something needs tighten. I am certainly no mechanic.
- In December of 2024 my daughter got into a little fender bender which is illustrated in a couple of the pictures above. I covered up the front bumper hole with some gorilla tape and honestly most people don't even realize there was a hole there. These cars are plentiful at junk yards, so it would only be probably a hundred bucks to get a new bumper cover if you wanted to replace it.
- Just today the car told me to check the tire pressure check system. I checked the tire pressure and it seems just fine. I'm not sure why it is alerting this.
- The check engine light IS NOT ON.

Ultimately this has been a great first car for my daughter. It got her to school/work and back and has been very reliable. If you are someone that knows how to tinker with cars and can easily fix the minor things wrong with it, then this car is for you.
